4) Confirm by reply when you’ve completed your updates.

- Today (Tue): managers update matrix and flag exceptions
- Wed by noon: I’ll assemble an initial exec pack draft (exec_review_pack_v1.pptx attached)
- Thu afternoon: leadership review window
- Fri EOD: final deck handed to Finance for forecast close

Attachments: pipeline_action_matrix.xlsx, exec_review_pack_v1.pptx

Thanks — keep replies tight (one-line OK) so I can consolidate quickly.
